description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AuthorizationException' used within the authorization component of the OrangeHRM system. It provides static methods for creating specific authorization-related exceptions with descriptive messages.

classes.name: AuthorizationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for authorization errors, providing static methods for specific error messages related to entity support and method implementation within the OrangeHRM authorization module.

methods.name: entityNotSupported
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type is not supported in a given method.

methods.name: entityNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type is not implemented in a given method.

methods.name: methodNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific method is not implemented.
